title: Defaults
description: Defaults v1: the answer of `lodwright defaults --json` and of `lodwright_api::request_defaults`.

levels.description: The terrain levels a request may list.

options.description: Every option a user can set, in request order.

version.description: The lodwright version these defaults belong to.

LevelDefault.description: The default of one terrain level, for an option set per level.

default.description:
The default, as the request holds it when the key is left out; `null` when the default is "the machine
decides" or "no limit". For a per-level option, see `per_level`.

key.description:
Where the option sits in the request, dotted: `terrain.water`, or `terrain.levels.quality` for a per-level
option.

maximum.description: The highest value `validate` accepts, for a number.

minimum.description: The lowest value `validate` accepts, for a number.

per_level.description: For a per-level option, the default of each level; empty otherwise.

power_of_two.description: The value must be a power of two.

since.description: The lodwright release that introduced the option.

tier.description:
1: shown to every user; 2: per-level terrain settings; 3: an option a release added, shown behind the
advanced gate.

OptionKind.description: What kind of value an option takes.

oneOf.description: A map from a text key to a number.
